# Exclusive attributes (K1, Q25): one group per line as 'name:word;word;...'. A thing
# has one of them at a time, so a conception with one makes a claim with another
# false. Only values that exclude each other belong together: no synonyms. In lower
# case. Two different numbers in the same place are exclusive too, by rule. A shade
# of a colour (azure, crimson) is not exclusive of that colour, so it is not here.
